name: mb_partialwarp
description: Minimal reproduction of the generic warp-reduction mass-drop under asymmetric (partial-warp) collectives followed by a block barrier and a SECOND full-warp reduce. warp0 lanes 0..7 run an extra 8-lane partial collective, __syncthreads(), then a full-warp SHFL.DOWN reduce with non-uniform values. A divergence-history membership model splits warp0 into {0..7}/{8..31} after the barrier and drops mass (so.193 cuDNN computeSoftmaxProbability<256,float> lost ~1.5% of its softmax sum exactly this way). The barrier is a full reconvergence point: the post-barrier full-warp reduce must see all 32 lanes. Fixed by warp_hist_resync_after_barrier (kernel_wrapper_75.h): a block barrier resynchronizes the per-lane divergence history to a warp-uniform epoch.
build_note: host pins args via ArgAt{0x210..} so default ARG_BASE is irrelevant.
result_x86: TEST PASSED (blocksum2 bit-exact post-fix; DIVERGED pre-fix)
